{{Quote|The sky changes. War rages. Seasons pass. Voss die. Voss remains.|Rasan-Je|<ref name="Encyclopedia" />}}
'''Rasan-Je''' was a member of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] who lived sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rasan-Je was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
